about: Questions for /ask: calibrating the abstention threshold (app.rag.calibrate) and testing the whole pipeline (app.rag.evaluate). corpus-01 to corpus-16 are the questions of corpus_questions.json; a01-a29 and u01-u24 were added for ADR 0004. 'sources' lists the pages that hold the answer, found by reading the manuals: one group for a fact, two for a conflict. A question without 'sources' has no answer in the corpus. 'must_include' is what a correct answer contains (a nested list: any one of these). 'split': the threshold is chosen on 'calibrate' and checked on 'test', so it is not tuned on the questions it is scored on. No manual text is stored here.
